blog.label: A Blog
blog.prompt: Build a personal blog page. Include a header with the blog name and navigation, a main content area showing blog post cards (title, date, excerpt, and a 'Read More' link), a sidebar with categories and recent posts, and a footer. Use a clean, readable layout with good typography. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

store.label: A Store
store.prompt: Build a store front page. Include a header with the store name and navigation (Home, Products, Cart, Contact), a featured products grid with product cards (image placeholder, title, price, Add to Cart button), a shopping cart sidebar that shows items and total, and a footer. Use a modern e-commerce layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

financial-adviser.label: Financial Adviser
financial-adviser.prompt: Build a financial advisory dashboard. Include a header with the firm name and navigation, a summary row showing key metrics (Net Worth, Monthly Income, Monthly Expenses, Savings Rate) with colored cards, a portfolio allocation chart section, a recent transactions table, and a footer. Use a professional dashboard layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

todo.label: A Todo List
todo.prompt: Build a todo list app page. Include a header with the app name, an input field to add new todos with a due date picker, a filter bar (All, Active, Completed), a list of todo items each with a checkbox, title, due date, and delete button, and a footer showing the count of remaining items. Use a clean productivity-app layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

notes.label: A Notebook
notes.prompt: Build a notes app page. Include a header with the app name and a search bar, a sidebar listing note titles with timestamps, a main editor area with a title input and a rich text content area, and a footer with word count and last saved time. Use a clean notes-app layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

weather.label: Weather Dashboard
weather.prompt: Build a weather dashboard page. Include a header with the dashboard name and a city search input, a current weather card showing temperature, conditions, humidity, and wind speed with a weather icon, a 5-day forecast row with daily cards, and detailed hourly breakdown for today. Use a weather-app layout with gradient backgrounds for different conditions. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

portfolio.label: Portfolio Site
portfolio.prompt: Build a personal portfolio / resume page. Include a hero section with name, title, and a brief tagline, a skills section with skill bars or tags, a projects grid with project cards (title, description, tech stack badges, links), a work experience timeline, a contact section with a form, and a footer. Use a clean professional layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.

dashboard.label: Analytics Dashboard
dashboard.prompt: Build an analytics dashboard page. Include a header with the dashboard name and date range selector, a KPI row (Users, Sessions, Page Views, Bounce Rate) with trend indicators, a main chart area with a line chart placeholder, a secondary chart row (bar chart, pie chart placeholders), a recent activity feed, and a footer. Use a data-dashboard layout. Style it in dark mode to match the webAgent theme.
